title: HemaAssist – FBC Auto-Comment Single-Page Web App (Frontend)

requirements.summary: Build a single-page UI for patient details and FBC value entry with a responsive form layout.
acceptanceCriteria: The UI contains input controls for Patient Name and Patient ID.
The UI contains input controls for each FBC field listed in the provided Python code.
The layout is responsive and usable on typical laptop screens without horizontal scrolling.

file_operations.description: Create the single-page layout containing a patient details section and an FBC values form (Hb, RBC, WBC, Platelets, MCV, MCHC, Neutrophils, Lymphocytes, Monocytes, Eosinophils, Basophils). Use shadcn-ui components (Input, Label, Card) to provide consistent, accessible form controls and grouping; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Ensure the app renders the new App.tsx single-page UI cleanly within the existing providers and that the entry remains SPA-only (no additional routes).

requirements.summary: Port the Python rule-based FBC auto-comment generation logic to the frontend and render an English report including patient details.
acceptanceCriteria: Given numeric inputs, the generated report includes a header line containing Patient Name and Patient ID in the format "PATIENT: <name>  |  ID: <id>".

Red cell comments match the Python logic: anaemia based on Hb (Low => "Anaemia present" else "No anaemia"), size based on MCV (Low => "Microcytic", High => "Macrocytic", else "Normocytic"), chroma based on MCHC (Low => "Hypochromic", High => "Hyperchromic", else "Normochromic").

White cell comments match the Python logic: WBC < 4 => "Leukopenia", WBC > 12 => "Leukocytosis", otherwise "Normal total WBC count"; differential adds Neutrophilia/Neutropenia and/or Lymphocytosis/Lymphopenia, or "Normal WBC differential" if none triggered.
Platelet comment matches the Python logic: Platelets < 150 => "Thrombocytopenia", Platelets > 450 => "Thrombocytosis", else "Normal platelet count".
All user-facing report text is in English.

file_operations.description: Implement pure frontend utilities to (1) normalize/parse numeric inputs and (2) generate the English report text that matches the provided Python rules and thresholds (Hb 12–17, MCV 80–100, MCHC 29–37, WBC <4/>12, Platelets <150/>450, Neutrophils >75/<40, Lymphocytes >45/<20).
Wire the form submission to call the fbcReport generator and display the returned report text in the output panel, including the required patient header line.

requirements.summary: Add required numeric validation for all FBC fields with clear English error feedback and prevent report regeneration on invalid input.
acceptanceCriteria: If any FBC field is empty or non-numeric, the app shows an error message in English indicating that all fields must contain numeric values.
When validation fails, the previously generated report (if any) is not overwritten by a new report.
Validation behavior is consistent across all FBC numeric fields.

file_operations.description: Create shared validation helpers that enforce all FBC numeric fields as required and numeric, returning a single consistent English error message when invalid.
Add validation before generating the report; show an on-screen error state when invalid and do not update/overwrite the existing report text.
Add a shadcn-ui Alert component wrapper for consistent, accessible error presentation; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Provide a slick output panel for the generated report and render the required medical disclaimer visibly in the UI.
acceptanceCriteria: After generating, the report is shown in a dedicated output area that supports selecting and copying text.
The disclaimer text appears on-screen and is readable without scrolling on typical laptop screens.
All user-facing disclaimer text is in English and matches the provided wording (excluding the emoji if desired).

file_operations.description: Implement a dedicated output area using a selectable text control (e.g., Textarea-like) to display the generated report, and render the disclaimer text: "For laboratory assistance only. Final interpretation must be done by a qualified practitioner." Use shadcn-ui Card/Textarea styling for a polished panel; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Add a shadcn-ui Textarea component wrapper suitable for the report output panel and any multiline needs; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Add primary and secondary actions: Generate, Clear, and Copy to Clipboard with English confirmation.
acceptanceCriteria: A button labeled "Generate FBC Comment" triggers validation and report generation.
A "Clear" action resets patient fields, all numeric inputs, and the output panel.
A "Copy to Clipboard" action copies exactly the report text currently displayed, and provides an on-screen confirmation in English.

file_operations.description: Add action buttons: "Generate FBC Comment" (runs validation + generation), "Clear" (resets all inputs and output), and "Copy to Clipboard" (copies current report text and shows an on-screen English confirmation). Use shadcn-ui Button for consistent variants and sizing; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Add a shadcn-ui Button component wrapper to standardize button styling and variants used by Generate/Clear/Copy actions; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Apply a cohesive modern clinical theme (non-blue/purple primary palette) with consistent typography, spacing, and component styling.
acceptanceCriteria: The UI uses a consistent visual system (typography scale, spacing, and component variants) across header, forms, buttons, and output panel.
The design avoids a default/unstyled appearance; the app looks intentionally designed and professional.
The theme does not rely on blue/purple as the primary palette.

file_operations.description: Add Tailwind base layers and define the app’s CSS variable theme tokens (background/foreground/primary/etc.) with a neutral + hematology-appropriate accent palette (avoid blue/purple as primary), ensuring consistent typography and spacing across the app.

Adjust Tailwind theme extension settings as needed to support the chosen non-blue/purple clinical palette and consistent component radii/shadows (keeping the existing CSS-variable-based color system).
Add a shadcn-ui Card component wrapper to provide consistent section framing for form groups and output panel; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Add a shadcn-ui Input component wrapper to provide consistent styling and focus states for all single-line fields; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Add a shadcn-ui Label component wrapper for accessible form labeling; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Add shared frontend utilities (e.g., className merging helpers) typically used by shadcn-ui components to enforce consistent styling; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Include required generated branding images as static assets under frontend/public/assets/generated and render them in the UI.
acceptanceCriteria: The generated image assets exist under frontend/public/assets/generated and are referenced directly by the frontend.
A logo/app mark is visible in the UI (e.g., in the header) and looks crisp on standard and high-DPI displays.

file_operations.description: Add the generated static logo asset at frontend/public/assets/generated/hemaassist-logo.dim_512x512.png for direct frontend use (no backend routing).
Add the generated wide header banner asset at frontend/public/assets/generated/hemaassist-banner.dim_1600x400.png for direct frontend use (no backend routing).

Render the logo and banner in the app header (referencing frontend/public/assets/generated/hemaassist-logo.dim_512x512.png and frontend/public/assets/generated/hemaassist-banner.dim_1600x400.png) with responsive sizing so they remain crisp and do not cause horizontal scrolling.
